Use polished Minecraft creature geometry: actual flat cuboid surfaces, expressive squared head, crisp low-resolution pixel textures with controlled 3–5 tone shading, and species-specific silhouettes. No smooth rounded anatomy, no illustration, no photorealistic fur. All ears, horns, paws/hooves and whole tail safely inside frame, 5 percent transparent margins, no cropping, no second view or inset portrait. Natural standing pose and friendly attentive expression. Match the second reference's CLEAN ALPHA silhouette and soft EVEN ambient lighting on surfaces: no glow, no bloom, no soft surrounding aura or colored fog, no rim light. Background must be genuinely completely TRANSPARENT, including between the legs. No ground shadow, no ground plane, no pedestal, no scenery, no toys, no labels, no letters, no watermark. This will be a small in-app game companion, so keep its face readable. Species-specific design: A recognizable red FOX with vivid burnt-orange coat, creamy white muzzle, fluffy white chest and white tail tip, dark brown/black lower legs and ears, small black nose, intelligent friendly dark brown eyes, two pointed upright ears and a very bushy angular long tail. Slender fox body and narrow projecting muzzle. Stand on all four legs, alert and kind, no collar.
